title: Observe one dispatch end to end
description: Pick a dispatch in this workspace; this one will do. Capture what Harbour records about it, what the host shows while it runs, and what it leaves behind. Write it up with the LH F05 study skeleton in studies/LH000/ and leave unfillable fields blank. Done when the write-up exists and says what could not be filled.

title: Export Harbour's records
description: A script that pulls this workspace's dispatch, feedback, usage and audit records through a read token and stores them with a collection timestamp, so that nothing ages past Harbour's thirty-day retention. While Harbour runs locally from this repository, the driver exports at the end of every session with harbour/hb export; the weekly cadence applies to the hosted version. Done when one export has run and its instrument record in registers/instruments.md says what it cannot see.

title: Sample the host
description: A sampler for the machine that claims dispatches: process activity, busy core seconds and requests per destination, at a stated interval, tagged as Lighthouse traffic. Post one sample per dispatch to Harbour as a resources feedback entry. Done when it has captured an idle baseline and one dispatch, with its own overhead measured.

title: Start the question register
description: Enter LH F04's follow-up questions into registers/questions.md with a reason each matters, using the entry form in LH F05. Score nothing yet. Done when the register exists.

title: Keep a ledger
description: Cost per study from the export, split by whether a person or the autopilot initiated the work, in registers/ledger.md. Done when the first session's figures exist.

title: Check the sources
description: Fetch every source in LH F02 and note anything that has moved or changed, in a dated entry. Run monthly. Done when the first check has run.

title: Survey of surveys
description: Reading only. List the observatories that already exist, such as GH Archive, Cloudflare Radar, Software Heritage, Open Source Insights, OpenRouter's rankings and the vulnerability databases, with the layer each sees, its population, boundary, unit, cadence and licence, in studies/LH003/. Done when every candidate has a row or a reason for exclusion.

title: A historical propagation case
description: Retell the xz backdoor through activity, residue and propagation from the public record, noting which layer carried the first detectable signal and which LH F02 instrument would have recorded it. An essay in the Harbour standard's essay form with an annotated reading list, in studies/LH004/. Done when the essay exists with its reading list.

title: Which model should take which kind of dispatched task?
description: A research note. Compare the models available to the driver, Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, for the kinds of task Lighthouse dispatches: consumer chores such as polling, taking, running commands and posting feedback; collection scripts; source checks; reading surveys; historical essays; study write-ups; and review. For each kind recommend a default model and say why, using published pricing and capability descriptions and the one measured run recorded in CLAUDE.md. State what is not known. Done when notes/Q-0002-model-choices.md exists in the Harbour standard's paper form.
